betStructure.title: Why is my bet split into 3?
betStructure.intro: Your ante is placed as 3 equal bets (Bet 1, 2, and 3). Three times your bet amount is deducted, so a single bet is capped at 1/3 of your chips.
betStructure.pull3: First Decision (after the 1st community card): you may pull back Bet 3
betStructure.pull2: Second Decision (after the 2nd community card): you may pull back Bet 2
betStructure.ride: Bet 1 always rides. If your hand qualifies, each remaining bet is paid out.

tutorial.betControls: Set your bet amount. Three equal bets will be placed automatically.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose Pull to withdraw a bet, or Let It Ride to keep it.
tutorial.results: Check your hand, community cards, and payouts here.
